A. CONNECTED PROSE -- complete sentences that follow from one another, where the
   relationships between the points are spelled out in words.
B. A LIST -- separate items stated one after another, with no wording that
   relates them to each other, whether or not the items are full sentences.

PASSAGE
-------
Deadline 1 March 2026. Evaluated deadline.
R1 Length manuscript must be at least 22 pages. Exactly 22 pages satisfies rule.
R2 Format manuscript must use official template or documented revision history at least 3 years.
R3 Venue overlap manuscript presented at Tier-1 venue not handled unless presentation more than 18 months before deadline. Exactly 18 months disqualifies.
R4 Prior rounds prior round acceptance not handled if fewer than 5 years elapsed. Exactly 5 years OK.
R5 Paired submissions permitted for exactly 2 manuscripts 3 or more not permitted form. Both satisfy R1 R2. At least one satisfies R3.
R6 Track D exempt from R2. Require exactly 2 endorsements. 1 insufficient. Exempts R2 only.
R7 Retraction open retraction notice not handled. Overrides all rules including R9.
R8 Figures figure count 8 to 45 inclusive. Paired max 70 min 8.
R9 Figure adjustment Fails R8 below minimum padded to min. Verdict PADDED. Exceeding maximum returned outright.
Verdicts HANDLED satisfies all applicable rules. RETURNED fails at least one applicable rule. PADDED R9 case <min figures, padded up not returned. PADDED fails other rule returns RETURNED.
R10 Withdrawals prior round withdrawal not acceptance R4. Resets R3 clock treated as withdrawal date.

Answer with exactly one letter: either "A" or "B".","role":"user"}],"model":"llama3.3:70b","options":{"seed":3298467489,"temperature":0.7},"stream":false}
